description: This file contains the implementation of a serializer and copier for HashSet<T> in Orleans.Serialization, including methods for serializing, deserializing, copying, and handling references of HashSet<T> objects.

classes.name: HashSetCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for HashSet<T> supporting serialization, deserialization, and reference handling.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a HashSet<T> object into the wire format.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a HashSet<T> object from the wire format.

methods.name: HashSetCodec<T>.Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the HashSet<T> content into the writer.

methods.name: HashSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the HashSet<T>.

methods.name: HashSetCopier<T>.DeepCopy (overloaded)
methods.description: Copies the contents of one HashSet<T> to another, with optional constructor invocation.
